prompt:
Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1037
Claimant:
Thomas Anderson
Adjuster:
Valerie Rodriguez
6-23-24
Claim opened after the insured reported a low-speed collision in a parking lot with another vehicle backing out of a
space. The claimant was identified as the driver of the other vehicle and is reprseented by counsel, so all contact will
go through the attorney's office. Verified that the driver is named on the policy.
8-16-24
Obtained the statements from the claimant's attorney and reviewed the scene photos submitted with the first notice of
loss. The damage visible on both vehicles lines up with the impact described, and the rear bumper deformation is
consisetnt with the reported speed.
9-4-24
Spoke with the two witnesses listed on the report. Both independently described the same sequence of movement
and contact, and neither had any connection to either party.
9-17-24
Took the other driver's recorded statement. Their account of the collision matches the witnesses and the photos in
every material respect.
10-10-24
Received the medical records from the claimant's treating provider. The reported back strain fits the kind and force of
the impact. Treatment followed a usual course, with physical therapy tapering off as the patient improved. The
records also note a small strain in the same area several years ago that healed fully.
11-22-24
Spoke with the claimant through counsel. The account given was the same as in the first notice of loss and in every
later conversation. It is not yet fully clear from the file where in the vehicle the claimant was seated at the moment of
impact, so I have requested a seating description and a follow-up interview.
11-29-24
Checked the vehicle history and prior claim records. No earlier damage to the vehicle is on file. A neighbor who was
contacted informally believes the car had been damaged seevral weeks before the stated loss date, but that remains
an unverified recollection and has not been confirmed by any document or other witness.
12-20-24
Reviewed the damage estimate against the impact photos and the reported point of contact. The repair scope
matches the described impact, and no additional areas of damage were identified during reinspection.
12-27-24
Summarized the file for supervisor review. Liability and the accident itself are supported by witnesses, photos, and
the other driver's account. Outstanding items are the seating position question and the neighbor's recollection about
prior damage, which will be followed up with counsel before any settlement evaluation.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page
says nothing about. The ratings are listed from least to most suspicious.
- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- treatment_growth: Did the treatment grow beyond what this injury needs? Allowed: Normal, Elevated, Disproportionate, Extreme.
- pre_existing_condition: Did an earlier condition of the same body area add to the complaints? Allowed: None, Minor, Material, Predominant.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- account_stability: Did the claimant's account of the accident stay the same over time? Allowed: Stable, Clarified, Materially changed.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- known_loss_evidence: Is there evidence the damage existed or was known before the coverage started? Allowed: Weak, Moderate, Strong.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.

For each rated feature give:
- "rating": exactly one of the allowed ratings,
- "confidence": "High", "Medium" or "Low" (how clearly the page shows it),
- "quote": one or two sentences copied EXACTLY from the page that support the rating, with any
  spelling errors as they are,
- "reason": one short sentence.
JSON format:
{"findings": [{"feature": "", "rating": "", "confidence": "", "quote": "", "reason": ""}]}
